about.title: About
about.info.name: App name
about.intro: A local tool that adapts existing Steam game folders so WinNative can recognise them.
about.disclaimer: This app is not an official Steam, WinNative, or GameSir emulator app. It does not download games or modify game files or ACF manifests.
